name: browser-agent
title: A Browser Agent
claim: One agent does a task in a real browser from one line of plain words: it reads each page before and after it acts, hands the browser to the person for a step that is theirs, and answers from what the pages showed.

oneOf.why: The lead (openai/gpt-6-luna) when it is the only key.
The lead (anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5) when it is the only key.
An OpenAI-compatible gateway that serves the models under their public ids, instead of provider keys.
oneOf.where: your gateway's base URL, ending in /v1

keys.why: A model provider's key for --live (the run names its model by provider and public id).

oneOf.why: the browser a live run drives, which Browserbase sandboxes
the project the session belongs to

keys.why: a live run's browser: Browserbase, unless --local-chrome
With --local-chrome: the Chrome the run starts on this machine.
keys.where: Chrome for Testing, or your Chrome

keys.why: With --local-chrome where Chrome cannot start its own sandbox (a container with no capabilities): 1 starts it without one, so the container is the boundary.
With --local-chrome: a directory where the run's live view leaves the person's hand-off requests, so browser_request_handoff can reach a person.

programs.why: A recorded run makes a video of what the browser showed (frame.track) with it.

input.shape: examples/browser-agent/agent.ts, Input: the task in plain words, one line
input.default: an example folder's question.md (npm run demo:browser -- examples/<folder>)
